column1: # kwatch config metadata v1
resyncSeconds|Performance|Periodic safety resync interval in seconds; zero keeps event-driven mode.|active|
namespaces|Scope|Comma-separated namespaces to watch; leave empty to watch every namespace.|active|
namespaceSelector|Scope|Kubernetes label selector used to choose namespaces.|active|
reasons|Scope|Comma-separated event reasons to allow or exclude with a leading !.|active|
severityByOwnerKind|Alerts|JSON map overriding severity by workload owner kind.|active|
severityByReason|Alerts|JSON map overriding severity by detected reason.|active|
heartbeatMonitor.enabled|Monitors|Send a periodic external dead-man heartbeat.|active|
heartbeatMonitor.interval|Monitors|Seconds between heartbeat notifications.|active|
heartbeatMonitor.url|Security|External dead-man heartbeat URL; stored only through a mounted Secret.|secret|
activeProbeMonitor.enabled|Monitors|Run explicitly configured application probes.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.intervalSeconds|Monitors|Seconds between active probe rounds.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.timeoutSeconds|Monitors|Timeout for each active probe.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.failureThreshold|Monitors|Consecutive probe failures before alerting.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.autoServices|Monitors|Probe discoverable Service ports automatically; opt in to avoid unexpected traffic.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.excludeNamespaces|Monitors|Namespaces automatic Service probing skips, for default-deny ingress that does not admit kwatch.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.http|Monitors|JSON array of HTTP probe targets with optional paths, headers, and latency limits.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.tcp|Monitors|JSON array of TCP probe targets.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.dns|Monitors|JSON array of DNS probe targets.|active|
upgrader.disableUpdateCheck|Operations|Disable the update notification.|active|
telemetry.enabled|Operations|Send the weekly adoption heartbeat.|active|
maintenance.enabled|Operations|Honor maintenance annotations while preserving cluster-level alerts.|active|
maintenance.annotation|Operations|Annotation that marks deliberate maintenance on a resource.|active|
maintenance.untilAnnotation|Operations|Optional annotation containing the maintenance expiry timestamp.|active|
app.clusterName|Operations|Cluster name shown in notifications.|active|
app.proxyURL|Operations|Optional proxy for outbound provider requests.|active|
app.disableStartupMessage|Operations|Disable the startup notification.|active|
app.logFormatter|Operations|Log output format: text or json.|active|
app.insecureSkipTLSVerify|Security|Skip TLS verification for outbound providers; strongly discouraged.|active|
app.caBundlePath|Security|Path to a mounted PEM bundle for outbound provider TLS.|active|
healthCheck.enabled|Operations|Expose the built-in health endpoint.|active|
healthCheck.port|Operations|Port for health and optional diagnostic endpoints.|active|
crd.enabled|Operations|Watch KwatchConfig and supported CRD status conditions; restart kwatch when configuration changes; enabled by the interactive installer after installing the CRD.|active|
auditLog.enabled|Operations|Write structured incident lifecycle records to the configured audit sink.|active|
auditLog.output|Operations|Audit output: stdout or a supported output sink.|active|
templates|Operations|JSON map of optional reason-specific message templates.|active|
runbooks|Operations|JSON map of reason-to-runbook URLs.|active|
silences|Noise reduction|JSON array of scoped silence rules, including eventMessages substring matches for attached Kubernetes Events.|active|
ignoreContainerNames|Compatibility|Legacy container suppression field.|deprecated|silences
ignorePodNames|Compatibility|Legacy pod-name suppression field.|deprecated|silences
ignoreContainerMessages|Compatibility|Legacy container-message suppression field.|deprecated|silences
ignoreNodeReasons|Compatibility|Legacy node-reason suppression field.|deprecated|silences
ignoreNodeMessages|Compatibility|Legacy node-message suppression field.|deprecated|silences
kubelet.insecureSkipVerify|Security|Skip kubelet serving certificate verification for direct node stats reads; only for self-signed kubelet certificates.|active|
watch.secrets|Scope|Watch Secrets (values hashed, never stored); false removes Secret RBAC and Secret-based checks report that they cannot verify.|active|
